snippet.title: Memoriapolis - Banners and Wonders update Trailer
snippet.description:
The Banners & Wonders update for Memoriapolis arrives on April 28th, 2026.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228280/MEMORIAPOLIS/

Memoriapolis is a historical city builder where your city grows organically across 5 ages, from Antiquity to the Industrial Era.

Your goal: reach the Industrial Era and build one of three final Wonders — the Eiffel Tower, Neuschwanstein Castle, or the Statue of Liberty.

🏛️ What’s new in Banners & Wonders:

- Reworked faction systems with personalities and negotiations
- The Dynastic House at the center of your city
- Build iconic landmarks to define your city’s identity
- No more cycle limits or locked districts — more freedom to grow
- New maps to explore different strategies
- Steam achievements
- Select your difficulty to match your playstyle
And more!

🕰️ One city. Five ages.

Grow your city across centuries, balance power, interact with factions, and shape a city that is never quite the same twice!

#citybuilder #memoriapolis
